decisions.reason: Because this handle family remained on the website in both 2023 and 2024, management would read it as at least meeting a satisfactory aspiration level, so absent clear underperformance there is little reason to reallocate resources.

Its promotion from a mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests acceptance above the minimum aspiration level, making retention the likely choice while the firm continues building its electronic and multifunctional offer.

The product stayed listed across both years, which indicates acceptable performance, but the lack of stronger signals such as awards or expanded presentation leaves a somewhat higher chance of later pruning if portfolio pressure rises.

A dedicated page in both years plus major design awards signal performance clearly above aspiration levels, so this collection is very unlikely to be withdrawn and instead fits the firm's design-led system strategy.
